user.title: Connect to an Innotemp controller
user.description: Enter the address of the controller's web interface and the credentials you use to log in there.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the controller, e.g. 192.168.25.204 (without http://).
data_description.username: User name of the controller's web interface.
data_description.password: Password of the controller's web interface.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname, without http:// or a path.
